premises.text: Customer service is poor across various industries
premises.evidence_span: Customer service sucks. You all know this, you've seen it, on airlines, at hotels, at retail, at restaurants, at Starbucks, wherever.

premises.text: Empowering customers to rate service interactions can improve customer service
premises.evidence_span: allow people to rate the interactions they have, so that by shining a bright light on it, customer service gets better.

premises.text: A mobile app can facilitate customer feedback on service experiences
premises.evidence_span: So today we're announcing our customer service rating system, and we're going to walk through a couple of examples for you.

premises.text: Businesses can benefit from aggregated customer ratings and feedback
premises.evidence_span: we're going to aggregate all of those ratings together, and we will provide a portal, essentially, a dashboard for businesses where they can go in and at a glance see what's going on with their business.

premises.text: Rating systems can help consumers choose service providers based on past experiences
premises.evidence_span: you could look at the ratings for the two people and know, hey, maybe I want to talk with Sam instead of Bob.

value.text: Consumers can provide feedback to improve service quality and make informed choices
value.evidence_span: you just provided not only that employee, but also their manager with information about that interaction you had with that business and what you thought about the service.
